name: What preparations should I make before starting a side home addition project?

mainEntity.name: What preparations should I make before starting a side home addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting a side home addition, gather all relevant property documents, including your property survey, existing house plans, and any previous renovation permits. Consider your current and future needs to define the scope and function of the new space. Establish a realistic budget, including a contingency for unforeseen expenses. It's also beneficial to research design inspirations and material preferences. These preparations help streamline the design process and enable you to provide clear direction to your contractor, ensuring the project aligns with your vision and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before starting, gather property documents, define project scope based on needs, establish a budget with contingency, and research design preferences to streamline planning.
